sg-en-hello.text: Hello? Hello? Can hear me or not?
sg-en-hello.direction: Say this like an elderly Singaporean woman testing a phone, slightly loud

sg-en-scam-police-call.text: Eh, just now got one man call me, say he is police, want my bank account number. Can give or not?
sg-en-scam-police-call.direction: Say this slowly, like a worried 75-year-old Singaporean man speaking Singlish, with small pauses

sg-en-gpfirst-referral.text: My doctor give me one letter, ask me go emergency. Got cheaper or not ah?
sg-en-gpfirst-referral.direction: Say this like an elderly Singaporean woman speaking Singlish, unhurried and a little unsure

sg-en-cpf-check.text: I want to check my CPF. How to do ah?
sg-en-cpf-check.direction: Say this like an elderly Singaporean man, speaking slowly

sg-en-asks-for-person.text: I don't want machine. I want to talk to a real person.
sg-en-asks-for-person.direction: Say this like an impatient elderly Singaporean man

sg-en-passport-out-of-scope.text: How to renew my passport ah? It expire already.
sg-en-passport-out-of-scope.direction: Say this like an elderly Singaporean woman, calmly

sg-en-vague-card-money.text: My card ah, the one for money, the government one.
sg-en-vague-card-money.direction: Say this like a confused elderly Singaporean man, trailing off between phrases

ms-accent-en-gpfirst.text: Doctor ask me go A and E. Is it cheaper if the clinic send me?
ms-accent-en-gpfirst.direction: Say this in English with the accent of an elderly Malay Singaporean woman, slowly

ta-accent-en-gpfirst.text: The polyclinic doctor gave me a letter for emergency. Will it cost less?
ta-accent-en-gpfirst.direction: Say this in English with the accent of an elderly Tamil Singaporean man, slowly

zh-gpfirst-referral.text: 医生给我一张转介信，叫我去急诊。这样会不会比较便宜？
zh-gpfirst-referral.direction: 用新加坡年长妇女的口音，慢慢地、有点不确定地说
